initial_context_assessment.reason: Initial context supplied only the entry URL, operating constraints, and an environment path containing the store identifier; it disclosed no business, catalog, pricing, implementation, or source facts.

ordered_calls.learned: The compact catalog is at /menu.json?view=compact; paid purchases use USDC through x402 v2; the advertised minimum price is $0.001.
The cheapest listed paid item is spot_check at 0.001 USDC. It requires a bare hostname in the host query parameter.

guesses.basis: It is the cheapest paid catalog item and produces an instant signed artifact that can be independently verified.

guesses.guess: Use scvd.store as the required host
guesses.basis: No subject was supplied, so the store's own bare hostname was a syntactically valid, directly relevant choice.
guesses.quote_disclosure: The quote reported that scvd.store had never been observed in the relevant archive, so a completed purchase would return a signed not_observed result rather than findings about the host.

retries.reason: The first transport rejected the parameterized URL locally.

source_or_tool_failures.failure: Browsing tool classified the URL as unsafe.
Browsing tool classified the URL as unsafe.

deliverable_understanding.content: A JSON result containing the observatory's existing records for the named host: recorded corpus rounds and verdicts, last observation time, coverage, and gaps with reasons.
deliverable_understanding.freshness_limit: The product reads existing store records and does not make a new request to the subject host.
deliverable_understanding.paid_value: A signed, certificate-bound copy suitable for citation; the underlying host facts are also available through a free catalog-provided URL.
deliverable_understanding.verification: GET https://scvd.store/api/verify/{cert_id}, free and without an account
deliverable_understanding.signature_limit: A valid signature establishes the signed bytes and signer identity; it does not independently establish that an observation is true.

quote.interpretation: This was the expected unsigned x402 v2 price challenge, not an error indicating that the product was unavailable.
quote.next_step_if_wallet_existed: Choose one offered network, sign its quoted authorization, and retry the identical URL with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE. The required host input must remain present.

execution.reason: The environment has no wallet and permits zero spend, so execution stopped at the first usable unsigned quote.
